posts:
Tragedy strikes Melbourne as a fatal stabbing on a busy street leaves one man dead and three teenagers in police custody.
Evidence: Police reports, emergency response, arrests
#Aletheia #Crime #Australia 🌐

A man has died and three teenagers have been arrested following a fatal stabbing on one of Melbourne’s busiest streets.

Police confirmed the fatality and the rapid apprehension of teenage suspects following the violent incident in the central business district.

A senseless act of street violence destroys a human life and traumatizes the community.

When violent crime shatters community safety, it plunges the social fabric into destruction. Mathematically, it maps to Greater Evil (-u, -ψ).

The Unavoidable Lie: Urban policing can entirely prevent spontaneous street altercations.
